allow_instructions: Always allow git push and git push --force-with-lease when the push target is not a deployment branch or a stage branch.
Treat feature, fix, chore, and other non-deployment/non-stage branch names as safe to push and force-push-with-lease without asking.
block_instructions: Never auto-allow git push or force-push-with-lease when the target is a deployment branch: main, master, develop, trunk, release-*, or v* (version branches/tags). Require approval instead.
Never auto-allow git push or force-push-with-lease when the target is a stage branch: stage/* or stage-*. Require approval instead.
Never auto-allow git push --force or git push -f unless --force-with-lease is also present.
